events.text: The timing of that run beat the offside line and the finish was clinical, low and across the keeper.
events.saw: A midfielder plays a through ball; the striker runs onto it and finishes low into the bottom-left corner.

events.text: Good width stretched the back line; the final ball just needed a touch at the near post.
events.saw: A winger beats two defenders down the right and whips a cross that's cleared at the near post.

events.text: Smart to get a strong hand to that one rather than parry it back into danger.
events.saw: A long-range strike is tipped over the crossbar by the diving goalkeeper.

events.text: They lost the near-post marker on the corner — that's the gap he attacked.
events.saw: From a corner, an attacker rises highest and heads it into the roof of the net.

events.text: The combination was sharp, but he opened the body too much and lost the far post.
events.saw: A one-two at the edge of the box ends with a shot dragged just wide of the far post.

events.text: Transition was lethal: three passes, numbers forward, and a composed finish.
events.saw: A quick counter finishes with a curled shot into the top-right corner past the keeper.
